name: Unitree H2-X
summary: A full-size 1.73 m Unitree humanoid with 7 kg rated payload per arm and two hot-swap batteries, offered for security, industry and service work.

priceOther.market: Unitree list price (tax and shipping excluded)

germany.statusNote: Unitree shows a USD list price but no order page, and no German or EU seller was found. The shop.unitree.com front page, the RBTX humanoid category, the QUADRUPED Robotics H2 page, Generation Robots, MYBOTSHOP, Bipedal, Funduino and the Terra Robotics home page do not show it.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: 65+ kg with battery, varies by configuration

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: rated, about; peak about 15 kg; varies with scenario

specs.label: Operating time
specs.conditions: approx.; maker lists 8 h both static and walking, press reads the figure as standing endurance

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Wide-angle binocular head camera, wide-angle monocular chest camera, microphone array

notes: This base version has no dexterous hands and no secondary development; both come with the EDU version.
Maker says it is engineered for all-weather security work, but publishes no IP rating.
Security and rescue scenes in the launch video are staged.

openQuestions: Will Unitree or an EU seller offer it in Germany?
